competences: The learner convert kilometres to metres.
The learner convert metres to kilometres and state the units.
languageCompetence: Reads, pronounces, spells and correctly uses: length, kilometre, metre, conversion.
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to convert kilometres to metres.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to convert metres to kilometres and state the units.
priorKnowledge: Learners have measured lengths using a ruler and know metres and centimetres.

steps.content: Learners have measured lengths using a ruler and know metres and centimetres. Starter: Express 25 km in metres.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher displays metric length conversion chart, reviews the prior skill, and asks: "Express 25 km in metres." The teacher records learners’ methods and connects them to metric units of length.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners recall the previous skill, read the starter question, and explain which measurements or operations they would use.

steps.content: Metric length units: Length may be recorded in centimetres and millimetres. $1\text{ km}=1000\text{ m}$. $1\text{ m}=100\text{ cm}$. $1\text{ m}=1000\text{ mm}$.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher writes and explains the following worked content: Length may be recorded in centimetres and millimetres. $1\text{ km}=1000\text{ m}$. $1\text{ m}=100\text{ cm}$. $1\text{ m}=1000\text{ mm}$. The teacher demonstrates each substitution or operation, asks learners to explain the units, and checks individual working before moving to the next step.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the given measurements, copy the calculation steps, explain the operation used, and check that the answer carries the correct units.

source.quote: Estimating, measuring and recording length in centimeters and millimeters

steps.content: Example: kilometres to metres: Change $7\text{ km}$ to metres. $1\text{ km}=1000\text{ m}$. $7\text{ km}=7\times1000\text{ m}$. $7\text{ km}=7000\text{ m}$. Find the number of metres in $4.7\text{ km}$. $4.7\text{ km}=4.7\times1000\text{ m}=4700\text{ m}$.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher writes and explains the following worked content: Change $7\text{ km}$ to metres. $1\text{ km}=1000\text{ m}$. $7\text{ km}=7\times1000\text{ m}$. $7\text{ km}=7000\text{ m}$. Find the number of metres in $4.7\text{ km}$. $4.7\text{ km}=4.7\times1000\text{ m}=4700\text{ m}$. The teacher demonstrates each substitution or operation, asks learners to explain the units, and checks individual working before moving to the next step.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the given measurements, copy the calculation steps, explain the operation used, and check that the answer carries the correct units.

source.quote: Find the number of metres in 4.7km

steps.content: Example: metres to kilometres: Write $42000\text{ m}$ as kilometres. $1000\text{ m}=1\text{ km}$. $42000\text{ m}=42000\div1000\text{ km}$. $42000\text{ m}=42\text{ km}$. Change $2500\text{ m}$ to kilometres. $2500\text{ m}=2500\div1000\text{ km}=2.5\text{ km}$.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher writes and explains the following worked content: Write $42000\text{ m}$ as kilometres. $1000\text{ m}=1\text{ km}$. $42000\text{ m}=42000\div1000\text{ km}$. $42000\text{ m}=42\text{ km}$. Change $2500\text{ m}$ to kilometres. $2500\text{ m}=2500\div1000\text{ km}=2.5\text{ km}$. The teacher demonstrates each substitution or operation, asks learners to explain the units, and checks individual working before moving to the next step.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the given measurements, copy the calculation steps, explain the operation used, and check that the answer carries the correct units.

steps.content: Express 25 km in metres. Convert 4 km to metres. Change 800 m to km. Change 7 km to metres. Write 42,000 m as kilometres.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher sets these questions: Express 25 km in metres. Convert 4 km to metres. Change 800 m to km. Change 7 km to metres. Write 42,000 m as kilometres. The teacher checks each learner’s working, marks against these computed answers: 25 × 1000 = 25,000 m. 4 × 1000 = 4000 m. 800 ÷ 1000 = 0.8 km. 7 × 1000 = 7000 m. 42,000 ÷ 1000 = 42 km. and supports learners who confuse lengths, areas or units.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners solve the questions individually, show each calculation, compare marked answers, and correct any errors in substitution or units.

steps.teacherActivity: The teacher asks learners to explain their solutions to these questions: Express 25 km in metres. Convert 4 km to metres. Change 800 m to km. Change 7 km to metres. Write 42,000 m as kilometres. The teacher checks the lesson objectives against the written work and assigns correction of the final exercise item.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners explain their calculation methods, state the correct units, and correct the final exercise item after receiving feedback.

assessment: Mark the written working for these questions: Express 25 km in metres. Convert 4 km to metres. Change 800 m to km. Change 7 km to metres. Write 42,000 m as kilometres. Check the stated measurements, operations, final answers and units against the answer key.
homework: Correct and fully work this exercise item: Write 42,000 m as kilometres.
